for c in roommate_contacts:
    email = (c.get('email') or '').strip().lower()
    name = f"{c.get('first_name','').strip()} {c.get('last_name','').strip()}".strip()
    if not email:
        continue
    users = []
    vi=0
    while True:
        page = apis.venmo.search_users(access_token=venmo_token, query=email, page_index=vi, page_limit=20)
        if not page:
            break
        users.extend(page)
        vi += 1

    users_exact = [u for u in users if (u.get('email') or '').strip().lower() == email]
    print('Venmo search for roommate:', name, 'email:', email, 'returned:', len(users), 'exact:', len(users_exact))
    if len(users_exact) > 0:
        resolved.append({'contact': c, 'venmo_users': users_exact})
    else:
        # If no exact match, try name search as fallback (post-filter exact on name)
        # But keep strict: exact first+last
        first = (c.get('first_name') or '').strip().lower()
        last = (c.get('last_name') or '').strip().lower()
        if first or last:
            users2=[]
